label: Caregiving week
triggers: A household member becomes a primary caregiver for 3+ consecutive days
A dependent's care needs spike (illness, recovery, new diagnosis)

priorities: Protect the caregiver's recovery time and capacity
Keep essential household routines running with reduced effort
risks: Caregiver burnout from sustained executive-function load
Neglected maintenance routines accumulating into larger failures

departures: When external respite care is available, the caregiver-recovery priority is met without scope reduction
